meta_title: Making weapons and gear — The Lord of the Rings
meta_description: Guides, videos and tips for making LARP-safe padded weapons, shields, arrows, water bottles and other LARP gear for the Battle for Middle-earth.
title: Making weapons and gear
subtitle: DIY guides for safe padded weapons, shields, arrows and camp gear.
intro: Making your own weapon is half the fun. Here you'll find tested guides, videos and material recommendations. Bear in mind that every weapon goes through a safety check on arrival.
h_safety: Safety and the on-site weapon check
wip_body: This page is being filled with content gradually. We're planning: our own video tutorials, material reviews (foams, cores, glues), examples of weapon checks from past years, and a weapon-safety FAQ.
